Update and refit a choice model

Source: R/methods.R
update.choicemodel.Rd

Works on the stored call as stats::update() does, with multi-part formulas handled by Formula::update.Formula(): update(fit, . ~ . + x3) changes the first part, update(fit, . ~ . | . + z2) the second.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'choicemodel'
update(object, formula., ..., evaluate = TRUE)

Arguments

object

A "choicemodel" fit.

formula.

Changes to the formula (optional).

...

Other arguments of the original call to replace.

evaluate

If FALSE, return the updated call instead of refitting.

Value

The refitted model (or the call).
